# Moon colour map (vendored)

`lroc_color_2k.jpg` is copied unchanged from the NASA Scientific Visualization Studio "CGI Moon Kit". The 3-D Moon globe uses it as a surface texture, so that the globe works offline.

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Source page | https://svs.gsfc.nasa.gov/4720/ (CGI Moon Kit, ID 4720, page retrieved 2026-11-14T13:58:17Z) |
| File | https://svs.gsfc.nasa.gov/vis/a000000/a004700/a004720/lroc_color_2k.jpg |
| Retrieved (UTC) | 2026-11-14T13:58:40Z |
| Size | 2048 x 1024 pixels, 457 942 bytes |
| SHA-256 | `f7130a1822681fa7512d7dcfd40db8c10b9ba4f06777910348698260ed7a2170` |
| Projection | Equirectangular (simple cylindrical), centred on 0° longitude (stated on the source page) |
| Content | 2025 colour map adapted from the LROC WAC Hapke-normalised mosaic (643, 566 and 415 nm bands). Latitudes the mosaic does not cover are filled with the LOLA albedo map (LDAM) |
| Credit | NASA's Scientific Visualization Studio (visualizer Ernie Wright, scientist Noah Petro); LROC WAC data NASA/GSFC/Arizona State University; LOLA data NASA/GSFC |
| Terms | NASA content, used for information and credited as asked on the source page; NASA Images and Media Usage Guidelines: https://www.nasa.gov/nasa-brand-center/images-and-media/ |

The source page says that these images are "optimized for aesthetics, not science". The globe uses the map only for orientation. Every number on the page comes from the result packages.

Do not edit this file. `web/tests/test_viewer.py` checks the checksum.
